criteria.description: With Django 5.2 available in your environment, run python -m django startproject config . in a new project folder and python manage.py startapp inventory. Save version and folder tree. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add inventory to INSTALLED_APPS and create inventory/urls.py. Include it from config/urls.py. Explain project URLs versus app URLs. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement the shown health view and route. Request /health/ locally; expect status 200, JSON content type and status ok. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add a home view and inventory/home.html template with an EMIO24 heading. Pass shop_name as context and verify it appears in the response. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Name the home and health routes and use reverse() to resolve them. Show both resolved paths without hard-coding the URLs in the calling code. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Request /does-not-exist/ and record 404. Trace why your health view is not called. Distinguish routing failure from a Python exception inside a view. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Annotate browser -> URL configuration -> view -> template/JsonResponse -> response with actual filenames. Explain where models will enter the flow next lesson. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
